title: Thought Leader — Episode 2: The Last Mile
about: A labor organizer dies in a city that never laid a hand on her — cornered over seventy-two hours by three hundred gig workers who each thought they were dropping off dinner. Agents Voidt and Lamport have to decide whether a killing composed out of ten thousand legal choices is still a crime, and whether the app that composed it has an author or only a metric. A structured port of frame-theater-ep2.html, generated directly from that file's STORY graph, with the four-cornered v...

encounters.text: EP. 2 · INT. BASEMENT OFFICE · 0730 [FTC · §5 unfair practices · 15 U.S.C.] Mari Duarte died Sunday of exposure and a heart she was born with. No suspect, no weapon, no contact. The only thing that connects one end of that city to the other across her last seventy-two hours is one company's dispatch log. I'd like it explained, in writing, why three hundred unrelated deliveries are not a homicide.
